title: Chatfuel Pricing: What You Need to Know Before You Pay
metaTitle: Chatfuel Pricing: What You Need to Know Before You Pay - Mochi
description: Blog: Chatfuel pricing research points to plans starting at $69 per month, but the right decision depends on more than the headline fee. This guide explains how to assess total cost, channel fit and what happens after an automated conversation begins.
label: Blog

cover.alt: A cream Mochi weighs a coin beside a piggy bank as other mascots illustrate messages and booked calls in a sunlit workspace.

blocks.name: Content 1
blocks.html:
How much does Chatfuel cost?

Current third-party research surfaced Chatfuel pricing that starts at $69 per month. Treat that as a useful starting point, not a permanent quote. Software plans, included usage and channel-specific offers can change, so check Chatfuel’s official pricing and checkout pages before buying.

The headline price also does not tell you whether Chatfuel will be inexpensive for your

Before comparing plans, write down:

  • The channels you need to support.
  • How many contacts or conversations you expect to handle.
  • Which triggers and automated flows you want to build.
  • How many team members need access.
  • Whether the goal is support, ecommerce automation, lead generation or sales through DMs.

Search research places Chatfuel among the better-known ManyChat alternatives and commonly describes it as an ecommerce and WhatsApp-focused option. That may make it a sensible candidate if those are your priorities. If Instagram DMs are a serious sales channel, however, automation is only the first part of the decision.

blocks.name: Content 2
blocks.html:
Look beyond the monthly subscription

A chatbot can open a conversation immediately after someone comments, replies to a Story or uses a keyword. That is valuable because the person receives the first message while their interest is still fresh.

But an automated first response is not the same as a completed sales process. After the conversation starts, somebody may still need to:

  1. Understand what the person wants.
  2. Decide whether they are a good fit.
  3. Answer questions or objections with the right context.
  4. Follow up if they stop replying.
  5. Send a calendar or checkout link.
  6. Track whether the conversation becomes a booked call or customer.

This is where a low headline price can become misleading. If the team still relies on unread messages, notes, spreadsheets and end-of-day reports, the business may pay for automation while continuing to lose qualified people after the first message.

Calculate the wider cost by looking at the time spent maintaining flows, finding conversations, checking follow-ups and reconstructing reports. Then consider the cost of qualified leads who already expressed interest but waited underneath newer messages. You do not always need more leads. You may need to stop losing the good people already inside the inbox.

If that is the problem you recognize, try Mochi free for 7 days and organize the Instagram conversations your business already has.

blocks.name: Content 3
blocks.html:
Five questions to ask before choosing Chatfuel

1. Does it fit your main channel?

Do not choose a tool because it supports many channels on paper. Choose it because it handles the channel where your customers actually start and continue conversations. Confirm that the plan you are considering includes the exact channel and capabilities you need.

2. What changes as usage grows?

Ask what happens when contacts, conversations or messages increase. Check whether team access, additional accounts or higher usage changes the amount you pay. Model a normal month and a busy campaign month rather than comparing only entry prices.

3. Can you measure business outcomes?

Replies are activity, not the final result. If you sell through Instagram DMs, ask whether you can see which conversations became qualified, received a calendar link, booked a call or became customers. Also check whether you can connect those results to the content, ad or outbound message that started them.

4. Can your team find the right conversation?

Instagram puts the newest message first. That means a fresh compliment can appear above a qualified person who already asked to book. Consider whether the system helps the person handling the inbox prioritize qualified leads and follow-ups instead of simply answering from top to bottom.

5. What happens when automation ends?

Look at the handoff to a real person. Can the next team member understand the conversation quickly? Can managers see who owns it? Can the team prepare a timely follow-up without sending an irrelevant scheduled message after the lead has already replied? These details often matter more than the first automated response.

blocks.name: Content 4
blocks.html:
Chatfuel or Mochi: which kind of system do you need?

This is not a simple question of which product has the lower monthly price. The tools should be judged by the job you need completed.

Chatfuel is commonly considered when a business wants chatbot automation, particularly around ecommerce and WhatsApp. Evaluate its current plans directly if that matches your use case.

Mochi is built specifically around selling through Instagram DMs. It can start selected conversations, but its strongest role is managing what happens around and after that first message. It helps coaches, creators and info businesses:

  • Put qualified leads and follow-ups ahead of random new messages.
  • Give the team conversation summaries and context for the next reply.
  • Track calendar links from sent to opened to booked.
  • See how conversations move from new lead to qualified, booked and sold.
  • Understand which content, scripts, follow-ups and team activity create results.

A founder handling their own inbox can use this structure to remember who needs attention. A larger team can use it to assign conversations, follow one process and see what is happening without reading every chat.

Choose Chatfuel if its current channel coverage, automation features and pricing match the job you need. Choose a dedicated Instagram DM sales system when the bigger problem is prioritizing, qualifying, following up and understanding which conversations turn into revenue.

If qualified Instagram conversations are getting lost after the first message, try Mochi free for 7 days. Connect Instagram and use it with the real conversations already entering your business.
